key.name: modkey-xk-return
key.description: Move the focused window to the top of the master area.

key.name: modkey-shiftmask-xk-return
key.description: Focus the terminal, launching it if it is not running.

key.name: modkey-xk-j
key.description: Move focus to the next window in the stack.

key.name: modkey-xk-k
key.description: Move focus to the previous window in the stack.

key.name: modkey-shiftmask-xk-j
key.description: Swap the focused window with the next one in the stack.

key.name: modkey-shiftmask-xk-k
key.description: Swap the focused window with the previous one in the stack.

key.name: modkey-xk-t
key.description: Split the screen into a master area and a stack.

key.name: modkey-xk-m
key.description: Stack every visible window on top of each other, full size.

key.name: modkey-xk-u
key.description: Center the master area with the stack split to either side.

key.name: modkey-xk-0
key.description: Show the windows of all tags at once.

key.name: modkey-shiftmask-xk-0
key.summary: Apply every tag to the window
key.description: Make the focused window visible under all tags.

key.name: modkey-xk-1
key.description: Show only the windows tagged with 1.

key.name: modkey-controlmask-xk-1
key.description: Add or remove tag 1 from the set of tags being viewed.

key.name: modkey-shiftmask-xk-1
key.description: Apply tag 1 to the focused window, replacing its current tags.

key.name: modkey-controlmask-shiftmask-xk-1
key.description: Add or remove tag 1 from the focused window.
